llm_response.reason: Multiple search results reveal Nutra Pro Keto and this domain use well-documented scam tactics: fake celebrity endorsements, unrealistic weight loss claims, hidden charges, and misleading 'risk-free' offers. The site's URL itself was inaccessible (404), and SSL issues were noted, further raising suspicion. Warnings from AARP and BBB, as well as YouTube and testimonials, confirm it mimics legitimate commerce while attempting to defraud customers, matching major scam criteria: claims of free, urgency, fake testimonials/endorsements, ambiguous business info, and non-standard payment practices.
